gappers.catalyst_detail: Alphabet missed Q3 EPS and revenue estimates. Search growth slowed, AI spend rose, and an $8.2B unrealized loss on its SpaceX stake hit net income. Microsoft was ~+4% on its own print.
gappers.why: Earnings/revenue miss plus capex worries remove the growth-justifies-spend narrative; momentum holders exit.
gappers.impact: Volume 718k premarket is heavy for the session. Post-earnings gap-downs of this size usually drift or retest rather than fully mean-revert. Read-through: negative for AI-capex-heavy names, positive relative bid for MSFT.
gappers.horizon_reason: Earnings-driven, thesis debate unresolved (Morningstar calls it oversold); not a long entry without base formation.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Long-only strategy: a falling knife, fails Confluence rule. Would displace any stronger momentum holding; cannot clear 2:1 R:R at a sane stop below the gap low. Pass; a held GOOG position needs the -7% cut check.
